description: Lists the customer's own documents, for example the prenup summary and the waivers: the kind, the title, whether the customer agreed, the date of the signature, and a link to the app. Some documents are only in the app. Call read_document with the kind for the text. The customer agrees to and signs a document only in the app.

product.description: The product line of the agreement. Leave it out when only one agreement is paid.
